styles.name: Bastion

openingTechnique.name: Entrenched
openingTechnique.description: Begin each battle with Barrier equal to 5% of Max Health.

styles.description: All healing received restores 25% as Health and converts 75% into Barrier.

refinements.name: Rebuild
refinements.description: Healing received below 35% Health restores its full amount directly as Health instead of converting part of it into barrier.

refinements.name: Reprisal
refinements.description: Store 25% of enemy damage absorbed by your Barrier, up to 10% of Max Health. Your next damaging Essence adds the stored amount to its first direct enemy attack attempt.

refinements.name: Shelter
refinements.description: Split converted Barrier equally with the ally with the lowest health percentage; retain it all when alone.

upgrades.name: Prepared Wall
upgrades.masteryDescription: You also gain this bonus when you have no Barrier.
upgrades.description: When you receive healing at 80% Health or higher, Fortification grants extra Barrier equal to 7.5% of the heal.

upgrades.name: Hold the Breach
upgrades.masteryDescription: That heal also restores 20% more Health.
upgrades.description: When you receive healing while having no Barrier, Fortification grants extra Barrier equal to 7.5% of the heal.

upgrades.name: Measured Recovery
upgrades.masteryDescription: Any overhealing is converted into Barrier.
upgrades.description: Fortification’s normal healing split restores 30% as Health, up from 25%.

styles.name: Conduit
styles.description: Choose an equipped Essence as your Focus. In the base form, each of your other Essences builds 1 Charge when it casts, once between Focus casts, up to 3 Charge. Your Focus spends all Charge to power its immediate damage, healing and Barrier: 80% of normal strength, with a +20% flat increase per Charge.

refinements.name: Short Circuit
refinements.description: Your other Essences build 1 Charge every time they cast, even if the same Essence casts again. Store up to 2 Charge.

refinements.name: Deep Reservoir
refinements.description: Store up to 4 Charge, with each of your other Essences building 1 Charge between Focus casts. Your Focus's immediate damage, healing and Barrier start at 60% of normal strength and gain a +25% flat increase per Charge spent.

refinements.name: Relay
refinements.description: After your Focus spends 2 or more Charge, regain 1 Charge for its next cast. Its immediate damage, healing and Barrier start at 80% of normal strength and gain a +15% flat increase per Charge spent.

upgrades.name: Full Circuit
upgrades.masteryDescription: This bonus now works whenever you spend 2 or more Charge.
upgrades.description: Spending maximum Charge adds a flat +5% to your Focus’s immediate damage, healing and Barrier.

upgrades.name: Partial Flow
upgrades.masteryDescription: This bonus now works with either 1 or 2 Charge.
upgrades.description: Spending exactly 1 Charge adds a flat +5% to your Focus’s immediate damage, healing and Barrier.

upgrades.name: Emergency Channel
upgrades.masteryDescription: You gain this bonus at any Health, as long as your Focus spends at least 1 Charge.
upgrades.description: When your Focus spends Charge at 35% Health or lower, add a flat +5% to the healing and Barrier it gives you immediately.
